chars.ME: ME: a 22-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.AMINA: AMINA: a 21-year-old Moroccan young woman with a round friendly face, wearing a beige headscarf and a long olive-green abaya
chars.AMINA_HOME: AMINA: a 21-year-old Moroccan young woman with a round friendly face, now without her headscarf, long dark wavy hair down, wearing a modest pink long-sleeve cartoon pajama set

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the narrow entrance of a modest Casablanca apartment, AMINA opens the front door and ME stands on the doorstep with a school backpack, both surprised and awkward to find each other alone at home, morning light. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment hallway with patterned Moroccan tiles, AMINA walks calmly back toward her bedroom while ME, still in the doorway, watches her, puzzled. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles, ME heats a round khobz bread and a silver teapot on a gas stove, relaxed and hungry. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AMINA steps out of her bedroom door into the hallway with a confident cheeky smile, stretching her arms, the apartment hallway behind her. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the small Moroccan kitchen, AMINA leans casually on the kitchen door frame smiling, while ME freezes at the stove holding the teapot, eyes wide in comic shock. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of ME in the kitchen turning his face away toward the stove, cheeks red with embarrassment, sweat drop, comic awkward expression. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ME stands at the stove scratching his head, deeply confused and thinking hard, steam rising from the teapot, comic puzzled face. No text in the image.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the kitchen, AMINA laughs teasingly pointing at ME, while ME blushes and hides his face behind his hand, funny awkward moment. No text in the image.
